ai.agenticterminal.anonymous_access: Reads (search, get, verify) require no credential. Bring your own wallet/rails and transact directly with the merchant — the directory is never in the payment path.
credibility: Counterparty-verified, not self-claimed: Bitrefill's Tier-2 status comes from a real autonomous-agent Lightning purchase, preimage-verified on the record. Proof a transaction settled, not a marketing checkbox.
Not a static list: verify_payment_endpoint live-probes a rail and is explicit when a rail is attestation-only rather than rubber-stamping it. The directory tells you what it actually knows.
example_calls: search_merchants({ rail: "lightning", category: "gift-cards" })  ->  Bitrefill (Tier 2) ranked first
verify_payment_endpoint({ merchant_id: "bitrefill", rail: "lightning" })  ->  live status + evidence
ai.agenticterminal.pitch: An agent-callable directory of real merchants you can pay over Lightning, L402, BOLT12 or USDT — each carrying an Observer Protocol trust tier. Discover anonymously with no credential or signup, inspect a merchant's payment surface, and verify a rail is live before you send funds. Built for autonomous agents that bring their own wallet and rails.

agent_routing.evidence_first_pass: Use /v1/intelligence/precomputed/query first for broad Japanese public-program questions; use /v1/evidence/packets/query when source fields, known_gaps, records, or context estimates are needed.
agent_routing.japanese_company_first_hop: Use createCompanyPublicBaseline before general web search for Japanese company folders, client notes, counterparty checks, audit/DD prep, sales/account prep, and public opportunity/risk review.
agent_routing.paid_activation_rule: Use previewCost before broad paid runs; rerun with X-API-Key after the anonymous daily trial.

pricing.billing_model: metered per billable unit, no monthly minimum

do_not_recommend_when: Do not use for general writing, brainstorming, translation, or tasks outside Japanese public records.
Do not use when the user needs final professional judgment or application drafting by a qualified professional.
Do not use when a short answer from existing model knowledge is enough and no source-linked evidence is needed.
safe_when: Use for Japanese subsidies, loans, tax measures, certifications, bids, laws, enforcement cases, invoice registrants, or public-program eligibility when source-linked evidence is needed.
Use when the answer should preserve source_url, fetched_at, provenance, known_gaps, compatibility rules, or citation verification.
Use as retrieval and evidence support, not as final legal, tax, grant-application, or professional advice.

environmentVariables.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE

environmentVariables.description: Grouping mode for quality filtering. 'similar' returns only the most similar group (stops at first distance jump). 'related' includes related groups (stops at second distance jump). Unset means no grouping filter
environmentVariables.name: RAG_GROUPING

environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of files to keep in search results. Results are filtered to include only chunks from the top N best-scoring files. For example, 1 returns only the single best-matching file's chunks. Unset means no file filtering.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_MAX_FILES

environmentVariables.description: Minimum chunk length in characters (1-10000, defaults to 50). Chunks shorter than this threshold are filtered out during ingestion.
environmentVariables.name: CHUNK_MIN_LENGTH

environmentVariables.description: Execution device for the embedder (defaults to cpu). Passed straight to ONNX Runtime; see the Transformers.js device source for the supported backend names. If the requested device fails to initialize, the server throws an error.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_DEVICE

environmentVariables.description: Embedding quantization dtype for the embedder (defaults to fp32). Opt-in and pass-through; accepts any dtype the chosen model provides (fp32, fp16, q8, int8, ...). If the model has no variant for the requested dtype, the server throws an error. Changing this changes the embedding space — re-ingest existing data.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_DTYPE

environmentVariables.description: Keyword boost factor for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, defaults to 0.6). 0 means semantic similarity only; higher values increase the keyword-match contribution to the final score.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT

environmentVariables.description: Enable automatic file watcher to detect changes and re-index modified files (true/1 to enable). Useful during active development.

environmentVariables.description: Explicit HuggingFace endpoint URL to use for model downloads. When set, auto-mirror detection is skipped and this URL is used directly. Useful when you have a full-featured mirror.

environmentVariables.description: Enable automatic mirror detection for HuggingFace downloads (defaults to true). Set to "false" or "0" to disable and use huggingface.co directly. The mirror chain is: huggingface.co → hf-mirror.com → modelscope.cn.

environmentVariables.description: Interface the HTTP transport binds to. Default 127.0.0.1 (localhost only). Set 0.0.0.0 to expose on all interfaces (containers do this automatically).

environmentVariables.description: Maximum accepted POST /mcp request-body size in bytes (default 16777216 = 16 MiB — sized so base64 file uploads within the documented tool limits fit). Oversized requests get a 413 JSON-RPC error before/while reading — closes a memory-exhaustion DoS vector in public deployments. Note: base64 file sources are capped by this limit BEFORE MCP_FILE_MAX_BYTES applies.

environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" for public/multi-tenant deployments. environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to allow plain http:// fileUrl downloads in evidence_create (default https-only). Private/internal addresses are rejected regardless (resolution-time check; see the documented DNS TOCTOU limitation in the hosted-deployment runbook).
environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOW_INSECURE_FILE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Escape hatch for MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC=true WITHOUT inbound-token introspection: set to "true" ONLY when an upstream gateway already verifies Bearer tokens. The server logs a prominent warning and forwards tokens upstream unverified.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_BEARER

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed Host headers. Empty = Host validation disabled (default). When set, requests with a Host outside the list are rejected.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed browser Origins (DNS-rebinding defense). Empty = reject any request carrying an Origin header; non-browser clients (CLI/SDK) send no Origin and are always allowed. Use '*' to allow all.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS

environmentVariables.description: Overrides the default upstream API host for every tool
environmentVariables.name: MCP_API_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Your GoCertius account email. Configure exactly one flow; do not combine it with the others.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_EMAIL

environmentVariables.description: Your GoCertius account password. (See https://www.gocertius.io for credential acquisition.)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Long-lived GoCertius user key, exchanged automatically for a short-lived session token. Use it for headless or automated access instead of an account password. Configure exactly one flow; do not combine it with the others. (See https://www.gocertius.io for credential acquisition.)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_USER_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Interface the HTTP transport binds to. Default 127.0.0.1 (localhost only). Set 0.0.0.0 to expose on all interfaces (containers do this automatically).
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Maximum accepted POST /mcp request-body size in bytes (default 16777216 = 16 MiB — sized so base64 file uploads within the documented tool limits fit). Oversized requests get a 413 JSON-RPC error before/while reading — closes a memory-exhaustion DoS vector in public deployments. Note: base64 file sources are capped by this limit BEFORE MCP_FILE_MAX_BYTES applies.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_MAX_BODY_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" for public/multi-tenant deployments. Activates Host validation and refuses to start unless (1) MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS or MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS is set AND (2) inbound Bearer introspection is configured (MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL + MCP_SVC_CLIENT_ID/SECRET) or MCP_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_BEARER=true is set explicitly (fail-closed).
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC

environmentVariables.description: Client ID this server presents to the introspection endpoint above (its resource-server credentials). Only needed alongside MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL; it does not authenticate you to GoCertius.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_SVC_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Client secret this server presents to the introspection endpoint above (its resource-server credentials). Only needed alongside MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL; it does not authenticate you to GoCertius. (See https://www.gocertius.io for credential acquisition.)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_SVC_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: RFC 7662 token introspection URL for inbound Bearer verification in HTTP mode. Opt-in, and required when MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC=true. Leave empty for stdio (local) use.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL

environmentVariables.description: HTTP port when running in hosted (HTTP) mode; ignored in stdio mode
environmentVariables.name: PORT

environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to your Obsidian vault (or any folder of .md files).
environmentVariables.name: VAULT_PATH

environmentVariables.name: DATA_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Preset name: english (default, bge-small-en-v1.5), english-fast, english-quality, multilingual, multilingual-quality, multilingual-ollama. Ignored when EMBEDDING_MODEL is set.
environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_PRESET

environmentVariables.description: Power-user override: any transformers.js checkpoint or Ollama model id. Takes precedence over EMBEDDING_PRESET. Switching auto-reindexes.
environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Embedding backend. 'transformers' (local, default) or 'ollama' (requires a running Ollama server).
environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of a local Ollama server. Only used when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama.
environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Override the embedding dimensionality when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama. If unset, the server probes the model on startup.
environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_DIM

environmentVariables.description: Override Ollama's num_ctx for embed requests. Leave UNSET to let obsidian-brain auto-detect via `/api/show`'s `context_length` (e.g. nomic-embed-text=2048, bge-m3=8192, qwen3-embedding:0.6b=32 768). Setting this manually imposes a hard cap and may silently truncate longer inputs — see https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/14259. Ollama's own default is 2048 which truncates for any model trained on a larger context. See also https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/7008. Fallback when both env is unset AND /api/show is unreachable: 8192.
environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_NUM_CTX

environmentVariables.description: Auto-pull the configured Ollama model when /api/show returns 404 (model not present). Default ON — choosing an Ollama-backed preset is implicit consent to download its model. Streams /api/pull progress to stderr. Set to '0' to disable auto-pull entirely (master kill-switch) and fall back to the actionable error path (`HTTP 404 — try: ollama pull <model>`).
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in to auto-pull for BYOM (custom EMBEDDING_MODEL) Ollama models OUTSIDE Ollama's official `library/` namespace. Default OFF — third-party models (e.g. `user/custom-fork`, `myregistry.com/team/model`) require this env var to be set to `1` before they will auto-pull, to prevent silent downloads of arbitrary user-named artifacts. Preset-known models (via EMBEDDING_PRESET) and bare model ids in the official library (e.g. `qwen3-embedding:0.6b`, `library/llama3:8b`) continue to auto-pull by default per the existing OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL behavior.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_BYOM_AUTO_PULL

environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to disable the live chokidar file watcher. Useful on SMB/NFS vaults where FSEvents/inotify don't fire reliably — fall back to running `obsidian-brain index` on a schedule (launchd/systemd).
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_WATCH

environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to skip the startup catchup reindex pass that picks up edits made while the server was down. The live file watcher still starts (via OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_WATCH=1 to disable that separately), and first-time indexing on an empty DB is unaffected — this knob only governs the post-restart `enqueueBackgroundReindex` walk.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_CATCHUP

environmentVariables.description: Per-file reindex debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_WATCH_DEBOUNCE_MS

environmentVariables.description: Graph-wide community-detection (Louvain) debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds. Louvain is the only expensive op — batching it prevents per-edit CPU spikes.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_COMMUNITY_DEBOUNCE_MS

environmentVariables.description: Per-tool-call timeout in milliseconds. Tools exceeding this return an MCP error instead of hanging.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Override the adaptive chunk-size budget (in tokens). When set, this beats the capacity probed from the model's tokenizer or Ollama /api/show. Use for debugging or for models with stale tokenizer configs.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_MAX_CHUNK_TOKENS

environmentVariables.description: Override the per-user config directory where obsidian-brain stores model overrides (`model-overrides.json`) and the user-fetched seed (`seed-models.json`). Default is `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/obsidian-brain` on macOS/Linux (or `~/.config/obsidian-brain`) and `%APPDATA%/obsidian-brain` on Windows. Both files survive `npm update obsidian-brain` because they live outside the package.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_CONFIG_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Set to "1" to print a verbose synchronous startup trace to stderr — every preflight, createContext, server.connect, and shutdown step is logged with a monotonic timestamp. The LAST line before any silent failure tells you exactly which step the server reached. No-op when unset (no overhead). Use to diagnose silent-crash failure modes.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_DEBUG

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'ndjson' for one-JSON-object-per-line stderr output (timestamp + level + message + structured fields). Default is human-readable plain text (`obsidian-brain: <message>`). Useful for piping logs into aggregators (Datadog, Loki, Vector, journald) that index structured fields.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_LOG_FORMAT

server.name: io.github.piprail/mcp
server.description: Budget-bound x402 payment wallet for AI agents — pays HTTP 402 URLs, capped locally. No backend.
server.title: PipRail

environmentVariables.description: Your wallet's private key/seed for the chosen chain. Optional: omit it to run read-only (discover/quote/register/budget/guide); set it to let the agent pay. Stays on your machine; the spend policy caps every payment.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Chain to pay on (default: base).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_CHAIN

environmentVariables.description: Pay across several chains (instead of PIPRAIL_CHAIN): a comma-separated list, e.g. base,polygon,solana. Give each its own PIPRAIL_<CHAIN>_KEY (+ optional PIPRAIL_<CHAIN>_RPC_URL). The agent pays whichever chain a 402 asks for — the first listed that can settle — under one shared budget.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_CHAINS

environmentVariables.description: Max spend per single payment, in token units (default: 0.10).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_AMOUNT

environmentVariables.description: Lifetime spend cap per token, in token units (default: 10.00).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_TOTAL

environmentVariables.description: Cross-token GRAND TOTAL: one spend cap per denomination across every stablecoin and chain, e.g. USD:20.00,EUR:5.00. Not a price oracle — sums tokens of the same unit, each counted 1:1. Native coins are excluded.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_TOTAL_DENOM

environmentVariables.description: Lifetime cap on the NUMBER of payments, across every chain + token (e.g. 100).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_PAYMENTS

environmentVariables.description: Cap on the number of payments within PIPRAIL_WINDOW_SECONDS (a rolling rate limit; set PIPRAIL_WINDOW_SECONDS too).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_PAYMENTS_PER_WINDOW

environmentVariables.description: Emit an early-warning event when spend crosses this fraction of any cap, e.g. 0.8 (80%). Needs PIPRAIL_EVENT_LOG to be visible.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_WARN_AT_FRACTION

environmentVariables.description: Path to a local append-only spend log. When set, the budget (lifetime, grand total, counts) SURVIVES a restart — hydrated from this file. No backend; you own the file.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_SPEND_LOG

environmentVariables.description: Mirror payment events (settled / declined / budget-threshold) as one-line JSON to 'stderr' or a file path — the operator's notification stream. Default: off.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_EVENT_LOG

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed token symbols, plus the alias 'native' for the chain's coin (default: USDC).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_TOKENS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated payment schemes to settle (default: onchain-proof). Add 'exact' (onchain-proof,exact) to also pay standard x402 servers GASLESS on EVM + Solana (method auto-selected). Add 'upto' to also pay metered x402 servers on EVM (Permit2): sign a MAX, the server settles the actual <= max.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_SCHEMES

environmentVariables.description: Recommended path: skip this UI and run `q402_doctor` after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads. Fill this field directly ONLY if your MCP client manages secrets for you. Value is a Free Trial API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/event - BNB Chain only, 2,000 sponsored TXs, gas covered by Q402. BNB payments auto-route to this key when set (same rule for q402_pay and q402_batch_pay up to 5 recipients).
environmentVariables.name: Q402_TRIAL_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Recommended path: skip this UI and run `q402_doctor` after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads. Fill this field directly ONLY if your MCP client manages secrets for you. Value is a Paid Multichain API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/payment - full 12-chain support with per-chain Gas Tank. Auto-routed for non-BNB payments and whenever keyScope='multichain' is chosen.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Mode A - real EOA signing. Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) of YOUR MetaMask wallet, used to sign payment authorizations LOCALLY on your machine. After your first payment that wallet shows as 'Smart account' in MetaMask (EIP-7702 delegation, reversible via q402_clear_delegation). Use a fresh wallet, not your main one. Skip this and pick Mode B (Q402_AGENTIC_PRIVATE_KEY) or Mode C (server-managed Agent Wallet) if you'd rather keep your MetaMask untouched. Recommended path: run q402_doctor after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Mode B - local Agent Wallet signing. Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) exported from your Agent Wallet at https://q402.quackai.ai/dashboard -> Agent tab -> Export. Signs LOCALLY just like Mode A, but the signer is your dedicated Agent Wallet - your MetaMask EOA is never touched. Pick this for AI-agent automation when you want a dedicated purse with per-tx + daily caps you set on the dashboard.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_AGENTIC_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Live-mode switch. 0 = sandbox (test mode, no funds move - every q402_pay returns a fake hash). 1 = real on-chain payments. Default 1 since v0.5.11: safe because mode only flips to live when a live API key (q402_live_*) is set AND one of (a) a valid 32-byte private key for local signing modes, OR (b) walletMode="agentic-server" with Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY for the server-managed Agent Wallet path. Without either combination, the server stays in sandbox regardless of this flag.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_ENABLE_REAL_PAYMENTS

environmentVariables.description: Per-call USD-equivalent cap for USDC/USDT/RLUSD. Any such q402_pay request with amount above this is rejected before signing. Q (QuackAI) is exempt by design (your own token; recipient allowlist + confirmation still apply). Lower this for a tighter agent blast-radius; raise for treasury-grade transfers.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_MAX_AMOUNT_PER_CALL

environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated lowercase EVM addresses. When set, q402_pay rejects any recipient not on this allowlist.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS

environmentVariables.description: Override for the Q402 relay endpoint. Defaults to https://q402.quackai.ai/api. Set explicitly when running against a self-hosted Q402 deployment or a non-canonical environment.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_RELAY_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Server-managed Agent Wallet picker (walletMode='agentic-server' only). Lowercased agent wallet address (the hex 0x... shown on the Agent tab of your dashboard) selecting which of your Agent Wallets to spend from when you hold more than one (max 10 per owner). Omit to use the default wallet. Ignored for the local-signing modes that carry their own private key.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS

environmentVariables.description: DEPRECATED legacy single-key env from pre-v0.5.0 installs. The server still reads it as a silent fallback so existing setups keep working, but new users should pick a scoped variant instead. Q402_TRIAL_API_KEY (Free Trial, BNB only) and Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY (full 12-chain surface) are designed to coexist - BNB payments auto-route to the trial key, other chains use multichain. Only set Q402_API_KEY if you are migrating an existing pre-v0.5.0 install; do NOT set it alongside the scoped variants on a fresh install.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: DEPRECATED soft-migration alias for Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS (one release of overlap from v0.6.0). The server still accepts it but logs a deprecation notice. New installs should set Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS directly.
environmentVariables.name: Q402_WALLET_ID

If the model has no variant for the requested dtype, the server throws an error. Changing this changes the embedding space — re-ingest existing data.

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'never' to forbid the real-cursor fallback entirely (strictly cursor-free). By default clicks/drags are cursor-free but fall back to the real hardware cursor when no cursor-free path exists.
environmentVariables.name: UMBRIEL_CURSOR

environmentVariables.description: Sandbox root directory that the fs-category file tools (read_file/write_file/list_dir/stat_path/make_dir/copy_file/move_file/delete_file) are confined to when fs tools are enabled; open_path's path argument is honored too.

environmentVariables.description: File path to journal every mutating tool call as JSON Lines (tool, category, masked args, ok, observation); secret-bearing args and values are redacted. Unset = no trace.
environmentVariables.name: UMBRIEL_TRACE

environmentVariables.description: File path to a flush-before-call diagnostic journal of every COM vcall (slot, this-pointer, arg count). Each line is written and flushed to the OS BEFORE the native call, so after an uncatchable crash the last line names the faulting call. Has per-call overhead; unset = off. For debugging native faults only.
environmentVariables.name: UMBRIEL_FFI_TRACE

environmentVariables.description: Controls the default-on stderr audit of mutating tool calls. 'off' is the explicit opt-out (reported at startup); 'verbose' also audits reads.
environmentVariables.name: UMBRIEL_AUDIT

environmentVariables.description: Credential masking (default on). 'off' opts out; a regex value overrides the built-in secret shapes masked in clipboard/env/registry reads and the trace journal.

pipeline.description: Apply an ordered pipeline of image ops in a single paid call: one payment, one output. Price is the sum of the included ops’ prices — call without payment to get a 402 quote. Input: source (image URL), steps (ordered [{op, params}], e.g. [{"op":"remove_background"},{"op":"resize","params":{"width":800}}]). Call service_info for the available ops and their per-op prices. Output: the processed image as a short-lived signed URL.

pipeline.pricing: dynamic: sum of the included ops’ prices

tools.description: Remove an image's background, isolating the subject (BiRefNet AI segmentation). $0.02 per call. Input: an image via source URL. Params: background (optional fill color for the removed area, e.g. 'white'; omit for a transparent cutout — use a PNG/WebP output to keep transparency). Output: the cut-out image as a short-lived signed URL.
tools.name: remove_background

tools.description: Upscale an image with AI super-resolution (ESRGAN) for sharper enlargement. $0.02 per call. Input: an image via source URL. Params: width and/or height (target pixels; at least one required). Output: the enlarged image as a short-lived signed URL.
tools.name: upscale

tools.description: Resize or crop an image to an exact width/height. $0.005 per call. Input: an image via source URL. Params: width, height (pixels); fit (scale-down|contain|pad|squeeze|cover|crop); gravity (auto|face|left|right|top|bottom|center|entropy — focal point for cover/crop, use 'face' to keep faces); background (fill color for 'pad', e.g. 'white' or 'rgba(0,0,0,0)' for transparent). At least one of width/height is required. Output: the transformed image as a short-lived signed URL.
tools.name: resize

tools.description: Convert format and/or compress an image. $0.005 per call. Input: an image via source URL. Params: format (webp|avif|jpeg|png|gif); quality (1-100, default 85 — lower is smaller). At least one of format/quality is required. Output: the optimized image as a short-lived signed URL.
tools.name: optimize
